propositions: Superseded and duplicate tickets cannot be closed via standard transition path because the plan-review close gate demands a certified attestation that is unsatisfiable by construction for administrative dispositions

The plan-review close gate function lacks visibility into the close disposition/class parameter, making it unable to exempt link-backed administrative closes even though the completion gate already honors this evidence
A later change (fc20-2df1-426e-42ab) extended administrative dispositions to task/story/epic ticket types and updated the completion gate but omitted the plan-review gate, creating an asymmetry
Force-closing a superseded child ticket strips the completion signature from its entire ancestor epic chain, degrading audit attestation beyond the individual ticket

The fix must thread close_class and tracker parameters to the gate, reuse the existing _has_live_replacement_link predicate, and exempt only link-backed dispositions (superseded/duplicate) with live evidence present
